title: Capture
findingOn: Recording is on. {{files}} on the server, {{size}}.
findingOff: Recording is off. {{files}} on the server, {{size}}.
warning: Every capture is sensitive. It is an exact recording of what your devices said and were told, with nothing filtered: expect the Wi-Fi name, LAN addresses, the device serial and its signing secret, and in proxy mode the exchanges with PetKit including your account credentials. Read one before you send it anywhere. A deleted file cannot be restored.
listFailed: Could not list the capture files: {{error}}

record.title: Record traffic
record.on: On. Every device request and broker frame is written as it happens.
record.off: Off. It is a setting under Settings, and turning it on asks for your password.

confirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirm.body: This cannot be undone: a capture is usually the only record of what it was recorded to investigate.

files.title: Files
files.label: Capture files
files.emptyOff: Capture is off. Turn on Save traffic under Settings to start recording; it applies immediately, with no restart.
files.empty: No files yet. Traffic will appear once a device talks to this app.
files.storedBody: On this server only, in <path>{{dir}}</path>. Nothing is uploaded.
files.keptBody: Nothing prunes these: a capture is deliberate, so it is kept in full until you delete it. Total on disk: {{size}}.
files.deleteBody: Removes the file for good. There is no bin.
files.sharingBody: Read the tail first. Attach only the one file that answers the question.

tail.pick: Pick a file to read its last records.
tail.caption: Tail of the file · secrets are masked in this view only
tail.captionCount_one: Last {{count}} of {{total}} lines · secrets are masked in this view only
tail.captionCount_other: Last {{count}} of {{total}} lines · secrets are masked in this view only
